newsitem.title: USA: Versace family says committed to company's future.
newsitem.headline: Versace family says committed to company's future.

text.p: The brother and sister of slain Italian designer Gianni Versace said they remain committed to their family business.
"It must be remembered that Gianni Versace stood for the future and so of course we stand dedicated to the future of our company," said Donatella and Santo Versace in a statement released from Miami.

Versace was shot and killed at the gates of his Miami Beach mansion on Tuesday. Police said they suspect alleged serial killer Andrew Cunanan, who is also suspected of killing at least four other men.
Versace's killing has sparked speculation about the future of the powerful Versace design house, considered the quintessential symbol of Italian fashion.

There had been reports Versace was preparing for a public stock offering, especially after recent initial public stock offerings by Polo Ralph Lauren Co. and Donna Karan International Inc., but many wondered if the company would go on after the death of its legendary founder.

"Statements regarding our company, dreamed together and built together, will be made as soon as we feel they are appropriate. But we would like the world to be assured that the indomitable spirit, the amazing vitality and the faith in creativity that makes Gianni Versace so important to everyone is something that we are completely committed to and most capable of continuing, as he would have wanted us to," they said.
